verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's docs explicitly describe creating products and running test purchases that work instantly with 'No real money charged,' which is a sandbox-style testing environment distinct from production billing, and this ties into the documented AI toolkit/MCP flows for configuring products/entitlements. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox vs production data isolation (e.g., separate test API keys or projects) and independent/hands-on corroboration that sandbox testing via the AI toolkit doesn't touch production customer data.
